sources.title: Jev (AI model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Jev is a proprietary artificial intelligence model developed by TypeSafe AI, a San Francisco–based company founded in 2024. It was released in limited early access on 15 September 2026, alongside the announcement of a US$40 million seed round led by DCVC. [1][2] Jev is a discriminative model: it is used for classification or regression, not generation. It does not generate natural-language ...

sources.title: Jev classifier — typed classification without an LLM
sources.snippet: Jev is TypeSafe AI's first System One model, and the choice primitive turns it into a fast, typed Jev classifier. You define up to 255 options, send the state you want labeled, and the Jev classifier returns one key, a probability for every option, and a single confidence score.
